evidence: This challenging trip begins at 1120 m following a well-formed boardwalk in a gradual climb through the Mangatepōpō Valley.
The track ends at Ketetahi Road at an altitude of 760 m.
There is a private carpark near the end of the hike at Ketetahi.

doubts: The start is not named in the track description itself ('begins at 1120 m ... through the Mangatepōpō Valley'); F1 (where Tongariro Crossing meets Mangatepopo Road) is taken as the start from 'Mangatepōpō Road end' and 'Mangatepopo car park'. No feature exists for the Ketetahi Road end, so the end ref is null. The page does not say 'one way' in the text, but the track begins in the Mangatepōpō Valley and ends at Ketetahi Road, and DOC's distance says one way. Soda Springs Walk is listed both as the shared first part of the way (via) and as another walk.
